race.description: Wa Stockfeeds Family Day At Bunbury Mdn
race.comment: BOUTIQUE BELLE (5) has wound up strongly in both runs this time in, the latest when fourth at Belmont Park over 1400m. Top jock aboard and looks ideally suited at the mile now. Goes close. SOHO STORM (12) was beaten a long way on debut then ran a much-improved race in tougher grade than this last time. Has further upside and looks suited back out in trip now. BACK IN THE FOLD (10) wound up strongly on debut and looks ideally placed at the mile now. MYSTACHEENO (1) is coming back in trip after racing handy and boxing on well over 2013m latest. Can give a sight. LEAD CINGA (6) should be at her top now and cannot be underestimated.
